verdict.rationale: Logseq's local-first architecture (markdown files stored on-device, per logseq-docs-23/28) inherently gives users full control to delete or retain their data by manipulating local files, and export/sync features (logseq-docs-8, logseq-docs-10, logseq-docs-28) support data portability, but there is no explicit documentation of a formal retention/deletion policy or in-app 'delete all data' controls. Community evidence also disputes the 'privacy-first' framing, noting the actual privacy policy includes more tracking/analytics than expected (logseq-comm-20), undercutting confidence in retention practices for any telemetry collected. missing for 10: explicit retention/deletion policy documentation, in-app data-erasure controls, clarity on analytics data lifecycle.
